source: A check reads the project and reports diagnostics. A diagnostic is one reported issue with a code, a severity and optional fixes. {0} runs every check, and the editor shows the same diagnostics.
text: 检查会读取项目并报告诊断。诊断是一条带有代码、严重级别和可选修复的已报告问题。{0} 会运行所有检查，编辑器也会显示相同的诊断。
